finding.title: Recon:EC2/PortProbeUnprotectedPort
finding.description: A sandbox honeypot intentionally exposed for red-team training triggered a low-noise GuardDuty port probe event that is expected in this environment.

llm_analysis.summary: The finding indicates a port probe on an EC2 instance identified as a sandbox honeypot used for red-team training. The activity is expected and low noise, occurring in a controlled sandbox environment.
llm_analysis.rationale: The instance is tagged as a sandbox environment and is intentionally exposed for red-team training, which explains the port probe activity. This reduces the risk as the activity is expected and controlled. However, it is still important to monitor such findings to ensure no unexpected behavior occurs.
indicators: Description states intentional exposure for red-team training
Low severity (1.2) and low noise event
llm_analysis.recommended_action: Continue monitoring the sandbox environment for any unexpected or escalated activity. Ensure that the honeypot is isolated from production resources to prevent any lateral movement in case of compromise.

policy_decision.recommended_action: El recurso i-0sandboxhoneypot999 no esta en el inventario, asi que no se puede valorar su explotabilidad: se desconoce su entorno, su criticidad y si esta expuesto a internet. Revisar manualmente e inventariar el recurso.

fuente: Samples sinteticos de GuardDuty e Inspector en mvp/data/samples/
advertencia: Datos sinteticos de demostracion. Los findings estan anonimizados y el inventario, el historial y el catalogo KEV/EPSS son locales.
